top_choice_rationale: P003 rewards a mature, structurally verified design principle: organic structure-directing agents, new framework topologies and engineered active sites let chemists choose a pore and place a catalytic site, confirmed over decades by independent diffraction and microscopy and transferred to industrial catalysis by Corma, Davis and Zones. It is more settled and less overlapping with recent prizes than the modality alternatives; P001 follows as the most chemically coherent of those, though Ciulli's exclusion and the lack of an approved PROTAC weigh against it.
recusal_note: Research field overlap: my electron-diffraction work on zeolites places me in the same community as the B003 candidates (Yu and Tsapatsis are outside the proposed three names); no documented collaboration with Corma, Davis or Zones. Possible recusal consideration only; ballot completed.
